info.name: InternPilot AI API
info.description:
Every REST endpoint in .kiro/specs/internship-intelligence/design.md §8.

Select the 'InternPilot Local' environment (baseUrl, demoUser) and run the folders in order. 'List jobs' stores {{jobId}} (first job without an application); 'Create application' and 'Mark job applied' store {{applicationId}}. The run cleans up the application it creates.

X-Demo-User selects the seeded demo identity. It is NOT authentication; do not expose this API on a public network.

A collection-level test checks X-Request-ID on every response and the error envelope {error: {code, message, details}} on every non-health error.

item.name: Health
item.description: GET /api/health. The only endpoint that does not use the error envelope (design.md §8).

request.description: 200 {status: ok, database: ok, version} or 503 {status: degraded, database: unavailable, version}.

item.name: Profile
item.description: GET/PUT /api/profile for the demo user resolved from X-Demo-User (demo identity, not authentication).

request.description: Returns the demo user's Profile. Stores it so 'Replace profile' can PUT it back unchanged.

item.name: Ingestion
item.description: POST /api/jobs/ingest (design.md §11). Sources: fixture | remotive | arbeitnow | payload.

request.description: Imports data/seed_jobs.json and data/ingest/*.json (including files captured by the MCP ingestion-agent). Offline and idempotent. limit caps the total across files, seed_jobs.json first, so it is set to the maximum (500). Returns 502 INGESTION_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE if any data/ingest/ file is invalid or larger than 5,000,000 bytes (fix or delete that file).
Fetches the allow-listed Remotive API; on any upstream failure falls back to fixtures and reports fallback_used=true. Requires network for the live path.

exec: pm.test('source is remotive or fixture fallback', () => {

request.description: fallback=false: 200 when the API is reachable, else 502 INGESTION_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.
A Remotive-shaped response captured with the MCP fetch tool, posted as source=payload. Adds one example job (re-running updates it by external_id).
format is required when source=payload.
list[Recommendation] ordered by score desc, deadline asc, id asc.
limit must be 1-20.

request.description: 201 Application. {{jobId}} is a job without an application (set by 'List jobs').
A second application for the same job returns 409 DUPLICATE_APPLICATION.
job_id that does not exist returns 404 NOT_FOUND.
Status must be one of the 8 values with exact casing.
Partial update; status changes go through application_status.transition().
Interested -> Offer is not allowed: 409 INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION with details.allowed.
Existing Saved/Interested application moves to Applied: 200 and applied_at is set.
204 No Content.
Deleting again returns 404 NOT_FOUND (also returned for another user's application).
No application exists: creates one with status Applied and returns 201.
Removes the application created above so the collection leaves demo data as it found it (activity events remain).

item.name: Dashboard
item.description: GET /api/dashboard (design.md §7). Metrics are computed fresh per request.

request.description: All dashboard metrics, charts data, deadlines, activity and top recommendations.
Omit resume_text (or send blank) to analyze the stored profile resume instead.
Unknown job_id returns 404 NOT_FOUND.
job_id must be >= 1. (RESUME_EMPTY, also 422, is returned when both the request and profile resume are blank.)
Sections (role, technical, skill, project, hr) and prioritized prep topics.
Unknown job id returns 404 NOT_FOUND.
